home.cwSub: Build your own game in Visual Studio 2019, one chapter at a time.
notice.why1: This guide is now only about building your game. The write-up is a separate job, so chapters 19 and 20 have been taken out.
notice.why2: Your game can be about anything you know well, in school or out of it, such as the moves taught at a local dance class.
notice.why3: You make each part your own as you build it, so you change things all the way through, not only at the end.
notice.means1: Any step you have already ticked is still ticked.
notice.means2: No step asks you for screenshots, templates or written evidence any more.
notice.means3: Chapters 0 and 1 have been rewritten. Read them again before you carry on.
notice.means4: Build any 4 of the 8 game chapters, 11 to 18. You do not have to pick them in pairs.
notice.means5: You choose how many points each question is worth. Each game chapter has a new screen that shows you how.
notice.means6: From chapter 5, the Your turn screens show you how to change Summit Ready to suit your own game as you build it.
